title_en: Gao Zhiqing, Dai Yuqing v. Zhang Fengqing, Yuan Liping — dispute over a house sale contract
ruling_gist_en: An owner's condominium ownership of a building includes the ownership of the exclusively owned parts, the co-ownership of the commonly owned parts, and the right of common management, and these three rights are inseparable. When an owner transfers a house, the exclusive right to use the commonly owned parts that he enjoys based on the agreement on common management shall also be transferred together. The existing agreement on common management shall continue to be valid for the transferee of the house who succeeds to the owner's rights by succession. The transferor of the house shall assist in delivering the commonly owned parts that he exclusively uses to the transferee.

full_text_en:
Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing v. Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping

— dispute over a house sale contract

Ruling Summary

The condominium ownership of a building owner includes the ownership of the exclusive part, the common ownership and joint management rights of the common area, and these three rights are inseparable. When an owner transfers a house, the exclusive right to use the common area enjoyed by the owner based on the common management agreement shall also be transferred together. The existing common management agreement continues to be binding on the transferee of the house who acquires the owner's rights by succession, and the transferor of the house shall assist in delivering the exclusive-use common area to the transferee.

Plaintiffs: Gao Zhiqing, male, born on October 30, 1982, Han Chinese, residing in Jiangning District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

Plaintiffs: Dai Yuqing, female, born on July 6, 1983, Han Chinese, residing in Jiangning District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

Defendants: Zhang Fengqing, male, born on December 29, 1970, Han Chinese, residing in Qixia District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

Defendants: Yuan Liping, female, born on March 18, 1973, Han Chinese, residing in Qixia District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

The plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, filed a lawsuit with the Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, against the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, due to a dispute over a house sale.

Plaintiffs' Allegations: On February 21, 2016, the plaintiffs entered into a house sale contract with the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, to purchase from the defendants the house located at Room A, Building X, Shanshui Fangzhou Yayuan. In 2020, due to urban civilization construction, the plaintiffs learned that all owners of the unit had partitioned the unit basement in August 2007, and the partitioned small basement No. 7 was designated for use by the owner of Room A. However, the defendants did not inform the plaintiffs of this situation, nor did they deliver small basement No. 7 to the plaintiffs; instead, they continued to occupy and use it. On September 2, 2020, a dispute arose between the plaintiffs and the defendants over the use of small basement No. 7, which was not resolved after mediation by the People's Mediation Committee. Therefore, the plaintiffs filed a lawsuit with the court, requesting confirmation that small basement No. 7 belongs to the plaintiffs for use, an order for the defendants to vacate and deliver small basement No. 7, and payment of occupancy fees (calculated from August 1, 2016, at the standard of RMB 400 per month until the actual delivery of small basement No. 7).

Defendants' Defense: 1. According to the commercial housing sale contract between the defendants and the developer, the unit basement of Room A is not included in the public apportioned area and does not belong to the common area of the owners. 2. Six months after the developer delivered the house, the defendants received a notice to discuss the partitioning of the unit basement. At that time, everyone demanded equal division, but due to the structure of the unit basement, it could not be divided equally and could only be partitioned into small basements of varying sizes. Everyone obtained the right to use by drawing lots; the defendants drew small basement No. 7 and paid the partitioning fee of RMB 676. Therefore, small basement No. 7 is not an ancillary facility of the house and has no connection with Room A; the defendants can dispose of it independently. 3. After the plaintiffs purchased the house, the housing price rose sharply. The premium on the plaintiffs' house purchase within half a year exceeded the premium on the defendants' house purchase over ten years. Although the contract between the parties only stipulated liquidated damages of RMB 20,000, the defendants did not breach the contract by failing to sell the house; the defendants performed the contract without any breach. In summary, the house sale contract between the plaintiffs and the defendants did not stipulate the transfer of small basement No. 7 to the plaintiffs, and the defendants requested that the plaintiffs' claims be dismissed.

Facts Found by the First Instance by Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province:

On February 21, 2016, the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping (Party A), the plaintiff, Gao Zhiqing (Party B), and a third party, Nanjing Cunfang Real Estate Agency Co., Ltd. (Party C), entered into a *Stock Housing Transaction Contract*, stipulating that Party A would sell to Party B the house located at Room A, Building X, Shanshui Fangzhou Yayuan, No. 2199 Hongyun Avenue, Dongshan Street, Jiangning District, Nanjing; the construction area was 125.05 square meters, the interior area was 111.14 square meters, and the apportioned area was 13.91 square meters; the purchase price was RMB 1,980,000. After the contract was signed, Gao Zhiqing paid the full purchase price, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping assisted in handling the transfer procedures, and the ownership of the house and the land use right were changed to the names of Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing on March 29 and April 1 of the same year, respectively. Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping actually delivered the house to Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing on May 11 of the same year.

On June 25, 2006, the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, entered into a *Commercial Housing Sale Contract* with Nanjing Hongfa Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and purchased the house at Room A, Building X, Shanshui Fangzhou Yayuan. In August 2007, all owners of the unit where Room 101 was located jointly entrusted the property service unit of the residential community to partition the unit basement. A total of 12 small compartments were partitioned according to the total of 12 households in the unit, numbered in sequence, and the users were determined by drawing lots. Among them, small basement No. 7 was used by the owner of Room A, and Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping paid the partitioning fee of RMB 676. When Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping sold the house, they did not inform Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing of the situation regarding small basement No. 7.

On August 24, 2020, the plaintiffs, Dai Yuqing and Gao Zhiqing, notified the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, to vacate small basement No. 7 by the end of the month. Subsequently, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping did not vacate it, and Dai Yuqing and Gao Zhiqing changed the lock of small basement No. 7, leading to a dispute between the parties. On September 2, 2020, through mediation by the Dongshan Street People's Mediation Committee of Jiangning District, Nanjing, Dai Yuqing and Gao Zhiqing handed over the key to the basement to Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, and the parties agreed to resolve the dispute over the use of the basement through litigation. At present, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping still have sundries stored in small basement No. 7.

During the trial, to prove the losses caused by the defendants' occupation of small basement No. 7, the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, provided basement rental advertisements downloaded from the real estate intermediary apps "Beike" and "Woaiwojia", showing that the rent for basements of similar size was about RMB 600 per month. Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, in their cross-examination, argued that the authenticity could not be confirmed.

First Instance Opinion of Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province:

The *Stock Housing Transaction Contract* entered into by the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, and the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations and is legal and valid. The parties shall fully perform their obligations in accordance with the agreement. The parties shall follow the principle of good faith and perform obligations of notification, assistance, confidentiality, etc., based on the nature and purpose of the contract and trade practices.

I. Regarding whether the involved basement belongs to the common area of the owners. By law, other public places, public facilities, and property service rooms within the construction zone belong to the common area of the owners. In this case, the unit basement of Room A does not belong to the exclusive part of the owners in the condominium ownership of the building, but rather to the public facilities within the construction zone, i.e., the common area of the owners. Moreover, the unit where Room A is located is relatively independent in structure and function, and the basement of this unit can be used separately, having a practical interest in its use with the owners of that unit. Therefore, the basement of this unit belongs to all owners of that unit as a common area. Small basement No. 7 is a common area partitioned from the unit basement of Room A and assigned for the exclusive use of the owner of Room A; its nature remains that of a common area of the owners. The defendants' argument that small basement No. 7 does not belong to the common area of the owners and that they can dispose of it themselves lacks factual and legal basis and is not adopted by the court.

II. Regarding whether the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, should deliver small basement No. 7 to the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing. By law, owners have the right of common ownership and joint management over the common area. When an owner transfers a residential or commercial house within the building, the common ownership and joint management rights they enjoy over the common area are transferred together. The court holds that from the perspective of maintaining public order in the community and the interests of the owners, when an owner transfers the exclusive part, not only are the common ownership and joint management rights over the common area transferred together, but also the exclusive right to use the common area enjoyed by the owner based on the common management agreement among owners should be transferred together. The existing common management agreement continues to be binding on the transferee of the house who acquires the owner's rights by succession, and the transferor of the house shall assist in delivering the exclusive-use common area to the transferee. In this case, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping exclusively used small basement No. 7 based on a common management agreement. When Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping transferred Room A to Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, the exclusive right to use small basement No. 7 should have been transferred together, and Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping should have assisted in delivering small basement No. 7 to Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing. Therefore, the court supports the plaintiffs' claims for confirmation that small basement No. 7 is for their use and for an order that Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping vacate and deliver small basement No. 7. The defendants' argument that the house sale contract did not stipulate the transfer of small basement No. 7 and that they should not deliver it to Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing lacks factual and legal basis and is not adopted.

III. Regarding the determination of the occupancy fees claimed by the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing. By law, if a party fails to perform its contractual obligations or performs them in a manner inconsistent with the agreement, it shall bear liability for breach of contract, such as continuing performance, taking remedial measures, or compensating for losses. In this case, the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, refused to deliver small basement No. 7 to Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, constituting a breach of contract, and Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing have the right to demand compensation for losses. The contract did not stipulate a delivery deadline for small basement No. 7; Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing could demand performance at any time, but should allow Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping a certain preparation time. On August 24, 2020, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing demanded that Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping vacate and deliver small basement No. 7 by the end of the month. Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping failed to perform their obligation in a timely manner; therefore, the occupancy fee should be calculated from September 1, 2020. Taking into account the nature, area, and use of small basement No. 7, the court discretionarily determines the fee at the standard of RMB 180 per month. Given that Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping paid a corresponding fee when they obtained the right to use small basement No. 7, to reduce the burden of litigation on the parties, the court determines that the occupancy fee up to December 22, 2020, offsets the fee paid by Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, and they are not required to pay any further occupancy fee for that period.

In summary, in accordance with Article 60 and Article 107 of the *Contract Law of the People's Republic of China*, and Article 70, Article 72, and Article 73 of the *Property Law of the People's Republic of China*, the Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, rendered the following judgment on December 30, 2020:

1. Small basement No. 7 in the unit basement of Room A, Building X, Shanshui Fangzhou Yayuan, No. 2199 Hongyun Avenue, Dongshan Street, Jiangning District, Nanjing, shall be used by the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing.

2. The defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, vacate and deliver small basement No. 7 in the unit basement of Room A, Building X, Shanshui Fangzhou Yayuan, No. 2199 Hongyun Avenue, Dongshan Street, Jiangning District, Nanjing, to the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing.

3. The defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, pay to the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, the occupancy fee (calculated from December 23, 2020, at the standard of RMB 180 per month until the defendants, Zhang Fengqing and Yuan Liping, deliver small basement No. 7 in the unit basement of Room A, Building X, Shanshui Fangzhou Yayuan, No. 2199 Hongyun Avenue, Dongshan Street, Jiangning District, Nanjing, to the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing).

4. The remaining claims of the plaintiffs, Gao Zhiqing and Dai Yuqing, are dismissed.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, neither party appealed, and the first-instance judgment has become legally effective.
